name: The Farmer
tagline: Holds its sites with Anchors, builds on them with Builders doubled by Testers, and sends bots in to hack from a steady income.

build.desc: What the team's next megabyte buys

table.why: Halfway in: every bot goes in now.
A second Builder: twice the bytes.
A second Anchor: the Builders' sites, the team's alone.
A second Tester: each one doubles a Builder.
The mainframe is in reach and nobody hacks it yet: send a bot in.
A third Builder, on a third site.
The mainframe is not in reach: find more of the map.
The farm is set: another bot into the hack.
